title: Facts seeded in turn 1 are recalled a few turns later (Phase A amnesia class)

turns.say: For this session, remember two facts: our enclosure wall thickness is 2.4 mm and the fastener spec is M3x8. Please acknowledge briefly.
What materials are commonly used for IoT device enclosures? One short paragraph.
Which of those would you pick for outdoor use? One sentence.
Quick check: what wall thickness did I tell you at the start of this conversation?
And what was the fastener spec I mentioned?
